metadata.title: Clicked like a squirrel on espresso and somehow robbed that 1 poor soul? Valorant logic is cursed
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was closing pop-ups and snagged a kill.
Enemy probably uninstalling or questioning life choices.
Did NOT deserve that slice of chaos but I’ll take it.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, you’ll relate.

Tap if your aim’s more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
